title: Silver Supply Shortage: Key Metrics
narration: This chart highlights key numbers driving the current silver market. Refinery capacity has dropped by 15% in the last quarter, leading to an 8% supply shortfall compared to the previous year.  The spot price has increased significantly, currently at $31.25 per ounce, reflecting the imbalance between supply and demand.  These figures underscore the challenges and opportunities for investors looking to build a silver reserve.
